sections.heading: Who We Are
sections.text: Pawloc is a web-based platform developed to address the challenges faced by pet owners, rescuers, shelters, and communities when pets become lost or are found without their owners. Our project was created by students from the Information Technology Department of the College of Engineering at Western Institute of Technology. Our team combines skills in project management, UX/UI design, frontend development, backend development, full-stack development, and quality assurance.

sections.heading: Why Pawloc Exists
sections.text: We recognized that information about lost and found pets is often scattered across social media pages, community groups, barangay reports, and physical posters. Important posts can become buried, while incomplete information can make it difficult to determine whether a found animal is someone's missing pet. Pawloc was designed to provide a centralized space where these reports can remain organized and accessible to the community.

sections.heading: What We Believe
sections.text: We believe technology can help communities respond more effectively when pets go missing. Pawloc focuses on:
items: Organized lost and found pet reporting
Helping pets reconnect with their owners

sections.heading: Our Mission
sections.text: Our mission is to provide a secure and community-focused platform that makes lost and found pet reporting easier, more organized, and more accessible.

sections.heading: Our Vision
sections.text: We envision communities where lost pets can be reported quickly, found animals can be identified more easily, and shelters and rescuers have better tools to support animal recovery.

sections.heading: Help Us Keep Pawloc Safe and Helpful
sections.text: Pawloc is a community platform designed to help people report lost pets, identify found animals, and support rescue and shelter efforts. Everyone using Pawloc is expected to treat other users and animals with respect.

sections.heading: 1. Provide Accurate Information
sections.text: When creating a report, provide information that is truthful and as accurate as possible. Do not intentionally submit false information about a lost or found pet.

sections.heading: 2. Do Not Make False Ownership Claims
sections.text: Do not falsely claim that an animal belongs to you. If you believe a found animal may be yours, provide reasonable information that can help establish ownership.

sections.heading: 3. Respect Other Users
sections.text: Do not use Pawloc to:
items: Publish someone's private information without permission

sections.heading: 4. Protect Personal Information
sections.text: Avoid posting sensitive personal information publicly. Do not publish passwords, financial information, private addresses, or other information that could put someone at risk.

sections.heading: 5. No Fraud or Abuse
sections.text: Pawloc must not be used to scam users, request money through deceptive claims, or manipulate pet reports for personal gain.

sections.heading: 6. Appropriate Content
sections.text: Pet photos, descriptions, and other submitted content should be relevant to the purpose of Pawloc. Content that is abusive, threatening, fraudulent, or otherwise inappropriate may be removed.

sections.heading: 7. Help Keep Reports Useful
sections.text: Update your report when circumstances change. If a lost pet is found, rescued, or otherwise no longer missing, update its status when possible.

sections.heading: 8. Report Problems
sections.text: If you see suspicious activity, false claims, spam, harassment, or other violations, report them to Pawloc support. Our goal is to maintain a community where people can work together to help lost and found pets.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.intro: Pawloc respects your privacy and is committed to handling your information responsibly. This Privacy Policy explains what information may be collected when you use Pawloc and how that information may be used.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.text: Depending on how you use Pawloc, the platform may collect information such as:
items: Email address used for account verification
Information included in lost or found pet reports
Location information associated with pet reports
Information you provide when contacting support

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Information
sections.text: Information collected through Pawloc may be used to:
items: Publish and organize lost and found pet reports
Help users identify and locate missing pets
Improve the functionality and reliability of the platform
Protect the platform and its users from abuse or misuse

sections.heading: 3. Location Information
sections.text: Location information may be included in pet reports to help community members identify where a pet was last seen or found. Users should avoid including unnecessary personal information in public report descriptions.

sections.heading: 4. Account Security
sections.text: Pawloc uses account authentication and secure cloud services to help protect user information. However, no online service can guarantee absolute security. Users are responsible for keeping their account credentials confidential.

sections.heading: 5. Sharing of Personal Information
sections.text: Pawloc is designed to reduce the need for users to publicly expose personal phone numbers when communicating about pet reports. We do not encourage users to publicly post sensitive personal information.

sections.heading: 6. Pet Photos and Reports
sections.text: Photos, descriptions, and other information submitted as part of a pet report may be visible to other users when necessary to support the lost-and-found process. Please only submit information that you are comfortable sharing for this purpose.

sections.heading: 7. Changes to This Policy
sections.text: This Privacy Policy may be updated as Pawloc develops. Any significant changes should be reflected on this page.

sections.heading: 8. Contact
sections.text: For privacy-related questions or concerns, contact: Email: pawloc2026@gmail.com
